name: Rurikawa Yuuto
source:
One of the new participants.

He is often called cheeky or impertinent, and his default way of addressing others is through impersonal (and somewhat rude) pronouns or with a nickname he comes up with himself. 

[Edited from [url=https://wolf-game.fandom.com/wiki/Yuuto_Rurikawa]Wolf Game Wiki[/url]]
